files.patch:
@@ -27,3 +27,14 @@ updates:
       packages:
         patterns: ["*"]
         update-types: ["minor", "patch"] # a new major is its own PR (tasks/updates.md)
+  # The code scan's engine, in .packages/requirements.txt, PyPI's lock form, each wheel by its hash (#546, #654): each
+  # update read against its release notes and licence, its hashes taken anew, its wheels' PyPI attestation published by
+  # the same as 1.185.0's (GitHub, semgrep/semgrep-proprietary, pro-release.yml; PyPI's integrity API), and the scan's
+  # test run on its samples (floor rule 7).
+  - package-ecosystem: "pip"
+    directory: "/.packages"
+    schedule:
+      interval: "weekly"
+      day: "monday"
+    cooldown:
+      default-days: 7

@@ -19,6 +19,8 @@
     "changes"
   ],
   "grown": {
+    "timed: tests/code-scan-test.mjs -> Date.now": "The clock is what it guards: a description far past any real one is read in under 2 s, so the scan's reading of \"Scan false alarm:\" and \"Scan unread:\" lines cannot hang on a hostile description (#612).",
+    "process: tests/code-scan-test.mjs -> node:child_process": "Starting the programs is what it guards: the scan reads a pull request's diff through git, its own step installs the real engine with pip and runs it, and the test reads the scan's command line, exit code and printed mend on repositories it builds with git (#612).",
     "timed: tests/stryker-test.mjs -> Date.now": "It holds Stryker's run to its budget and a test to its limit with a fault in, both measured on the clock the run itself reads, which is what the test guards (#581).",
     "process: tests/stryker-test.mjs -> node:child_process": "It runs Stryker, another publisher's tool, as the strength step runs it, and stops a run by a signal: the process and its group are what the test guards (#581).",
     "process: tests/issue-terms-test.mjs -> node:child_process": "It runs the personal-terms check's own shell lines (its link and unlinked) in bash on each text, which is what holds the two matchers in step (#783).",
@@ -69,6 +71,7 @@
     "process: tests/cited-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
     "process: tests/clean-merges-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
     "process: tests/code-review-wait-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
+    "process: tests/code-scan-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
     "process: tests/code-shape-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
     "process: tests/comment-only-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
     "process: tests/copies-tools-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
@@ -140,6 +143,7 @@
     "process: tests/workflows-test.mjs -> node:child_process": true,
     "timed: tests/agent-tools-test.mjs -> Date.now": true,
     "timed: tests/cited-test.mjs -> Date.now": true,
+    "timed: tests/code-scan-test.mjs -> Date.now": true,
     "timed: tests/done-when-test.mjs -> Date.now": true,
     "timed: tests/dose-test.mjs -> new Date()": true,
     "timed: tests/hostile-configs-test.mjs -> Date.now": true,

@@ -21,8 +21,11 @@
 # copies.yml's (copies, sizes), pr-description.yml's (description, parts), signatures.yml's (signatures) and nuget.yml's
 # (nuget, advisory), each through the copy's scripts/checks.mjs, which holds their steps and says what each holds, as
 # those workflows run it. They run only where every step of its own check passed, so a copy not proved the core runs
-# nothing here; then each runs even where one of them before it failed, so every failure is said; the package
-# checks go last, each in a step of its own, and the NuGet check, which runs the pull request's build files, after all.
+# nothing here; then each runs even where one of them before it failed, so every failure is said; the code scan of a
+# project the host's CodeQL does not scan follows them, with any of those inputs and none of its own, its engine
+# installed from the core's .packages/requirements.txt by its hashes in a step before it (scripts/code-scan.mjs; #546, #654); the
+# package checks go last, each in a step of its own, and the NuGet check, which runs the pull request's build files,
+# after all.
 # One job bills one runner's minutes where four or five did (#377); with no such input it runs its own check alone, as
 # before.
 name: core
@@ -72,8 +75,8 @@ permissions:
 jobs:
   core:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    # (each part's own: this check 5 minutes, those of the copy's scripts 5, each package check 10)
-    timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.signatures != '' && inputs.nuget != '') && 30 || (inputs.signatures != '' || inputs.nuget != '') && 20 || (inputs.copies != '' || inputs.description) && 10 || 5 }}
+    # (each part's own: this check 5 minutes, those of the copy's scripts 5, the code scan 5, each package check 10)
+    timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.signatures != '' && inputs.nuget != '') && 35 || (inputs.signatures != '' || inputs.nuget != '') && 25 || (inputs.copies != '' || inputs.description) && 15 || 5 }}
     # (a pull request's run gives way to a newer one for the same pull request, whose head it no longer is; a run on
     # main, a schedule or a start by hand is its own group and is never cancelled; #388)
     concurrency:
@@ -351,6 +354,27 @@ jobs:
           GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }} # (read only: the base's commits and copy, and the issues a pull request queues or closes)
           PARTS: ${{ inputs.parts }}
         run: node "$CORE_AT"scripts/checks.mjs description --parts "$PARTS"
+      # (the code scan of a private project, #546: where no workflow of the base calls the core's codeql.yml, Semgrep's
+      # engine is installed from the core's .packages/requirements.txt by its wheels' hashes, with the runner's pip, before the scan
+      # runs and only where the change adds or alters a file the scan reads (#654), and reads those files with the core's
+      # rules, failing a finding the base did not hold; an engine not installed fails the scan, saying how to install it)
+      - name: The code scan, which a call with no input does not run
+        if: ${{ success() && steps.core-at.outcome == 'skipped' }}
+        run: 'echo "code scan: not run: core.yml was called with none of its inputs, so the copy''s scripts do not run here; the one job of the core''s setup/sync-notes.md, \"17 November 2026, the checks as one job\", runs it"'
+      - name: The code scan's engine, installed from the core's lock file where the host's CodeQL does not scan the project
+        id: scan-engine
+        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.core-at.outcome == 'success' }}
+        timeout-minutes: 5
+        env:
+          BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'HEAD^1' || '' }}
+        run: node "$CORE_AT"scripts/code-scan.mjs --install ${BASE:+--base "$BASE"}
+      - name: The code scan
+        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.core-at.outcome == 'success' && steps.scan-engine.outcome == 'success' }}
+        timeout-minutes: 5
+        env:
+          BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'HEAD^1' || '' }}
+          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
+        run: node "$CORE_AT"scripts/code-scan.mjs ${BASE:+--base "$BASE"}
       - name: The signature check
         if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.core-at.outcome == 'success' && inputs.signatures != '' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
         timeout-minutes: 10
